description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You or an ally within 30 feet fails a check, or a plan you stated aloud during preparation fails.

Declare the contingency you had already arranged. Choose one: reroll the triggering check with a +2 circumstance bonus; or produce one common item of your level or lower that you had cached nearby in advance; or reveal an escape route out of your current location that the party can reach this round.
